answer: An agent economy can require beacon-anchored work receipts: every trade must carry a receipt signed by an independent beacon node that witnessed the underlying work. A hollow identity with no witnessed receipts earns zero weight, however many keys it mints. The delta between claimed volume and beacon-witnessed volume is published, so a sybil cluster trading only among itself shows a huge gap and is throttled. One honest agent collects receipts by doing real work; a farmer must buy real witnessed work per fake, which costs more than the fraud earns.
